elements.title: Python code and output examples for indexing and selecting data in a DataFrame
elements.details: Two code blocks shown. First code block: print(data["US_Gross_Million"][0]) and print(data["US_Gross_Million"][2]) with output 760.51 and 659.33. Second code block: data.iloc[:, 1] with output showing index and movie titles from 0 to 965, including 'Avatar', 'Avengers: Endgame', 'Titanic', 'Star Wars: Episode VII - The Force Awakens', 'Avengers: Infinity War', 'The A-Team', 'Tootsie', 'In the Line of Fire', 'Analyze This', 'The Hitman's Bodyguard'.
elements.summary: This element shows Python code examples demonstrating how to access specific values in a DataFrame column using index numbers and iloc[], along with the resulting outputs.
